independentSelection.role: Independent editorial selector, not a retrieval or drafting agent; no subagent delegation. Final choices and scope labels are own judgments.

method.titleScreening: Every one of the 446 titles was individually displayed and read in ordered batches, indices 0-445.
method.abstractScreening: 128 candidates had one or more provided abstract texts actually read. Exactly duplicate supplied texts count once; 20 of the 148 candidates with supplied abstracts were not fully read. Truncated abstract 434 is deliberately not counted.
method.fullTextScreening: 15 fixed-version primary articles were read in listed focused sections; this is not 15 cover-to-cover readings. Availability/download alone is not a reading.
method.comparisonRule: Protocol relevance, identifiable mechanism, primary evidence and the editorial eight-paper limit; no probability or absolute score ranking. Primary topic limited to at most two.
method.scopeRule: topicCandidates reflects independent actual title/abstract/full-text judgment at scopeEvidenceLevel. A title-only direction is provisional. Empty does not prove that the unread full text has no transferable idea.
method.resourceRule: Do not infer official projects or code availability from sponsor/footer links, repository existence, or coming-soon statements.
method.memoryUse: Only current project preference for substantive stable selection rubrics and direction-based reading was reused; current rules and ledger were reread. Historical counts were not reused.

limitations: Source coverage is that of the frozen 42-family union, not a claim of exhaustive global literature search.
Title-only exclusions are bounded to visible evidence; 20 supplied-abstract candidates and all non-compared full texts remain incompletely assessed.

Many related candidates are deferred by editorial capacity. A deferred record is not a scientific rejection, no-research finding, no-code finding, or a claim that selected papers dominate every comparator.
Selection is same-family provisional and needs writing-stage source checks plus independent final review; no experiments were run.

scopeCoverage.label: 协同自动驾驶
scopeCoverage.scopeCoverage: 选择 SemRD 的固定预算与计算边界。PEARL、Frugal、ITS Fairy 已阅读全文重点；异构、应用闭环与完整无线链路是不同问题，未入选主要是篇幅取舍。

scopeCoverage.label: Agentic Driving
scopeCoverage.scopeCoverage: 选择有真实模拟器反馈、历史和停滞触发的 Teach-to-Crash。一次 VLA 前向的 RefineDrive/CAR-VLA 不因语言或训练期诊断自动计为 Agentic。SE-LLM-OCP 等留作后续。

scopeCoverage.label: 三维重建
scopeCoverage.scopeCoverage: 本期无主选。已全文重点比较 OneFixer；其闭环证据是与策略训练场景重叠的渲染重放保真。RECAST、M3GD 等也是直接候选；此缺口主要是八篇篇幅与 priority 1 优先。

scopeCoverage.label: 动态场景表征与占据
scopeCoverage.scopeCoverage: 选择 RoadOcc；TriO 提供交叉占据证据。路侧不自动等于跨车协作，当前状态/历史融合不自动等于动作条件世界模型。SplatLabel 等是篇幅取舍。

scopeCoverage.label: 自动驾驶攻防与韧性
scopeCoverage.scopeCoverage: 主选 TrackFlood，限定数字白盒与顺序端侧执行。SDTP、GNSS、V2X误行为、RMOT攻击仍是候选；暂缓不代表没有研究或没有代码。

scopeCoverage.label: 自动驾驶测试
scopeCoverage.scopeCoverage: 主选 Metric Validity，Teach-to-Crash 交叉覆盖。DriveHierarchy 已全文比较，其余 NavSafe、CausalDriveBench、VehDyn 等因为篇幅未全面阅读，不能据此宣称基准空白。

scopeCoverage.label: 端到端自动驾驶
scopeCoverage.scopeCoverage: ECO 为主标签；Metric Validity 与 RCVLA 为交叉阅读。其余 VLA/latent-planning 候选多为篇幅暂缓，不按 NAVSIM 绝对分数跨协议排名。

scopeCoverage.label: 世界模型
scopeCoverage.scopeCoverage: 本期无主选。HelloWorld、DreamStream、BranchDrive、VehDyn、CoDrive 等实际摘要已读，具有直接关系但未全面全文比较；缺口是篇幅取舍，绝非方向没有新工作。TriO 的无动作条件占据预测不为凑数计入本方向。

scopeCoverage.label: 雷达中心的时空占据与场景表征
scopeCoverage.scopeCoverage: 选择 RCVLA，TriO 的雷达证据限 LRR；Dr-LiSA 全文有真实道路定位验证但暂缓。FMCW LiDAR 不混作毫米波雷达。没有声称本期没有雷达占据研究。

scopeCoverage.label: 三维异常分割与开放集感知
scopeCoverage.scopeCoverage: 选择 TriO 作为道路未知障碍问题的近邻方法，明确障碍/地面协议与 STU 标准异常协议不等价。工业缺陷摘要已识别并排除；不以工业 AUROC 凑方向。
